ai_review.summary: Audience recording of a hot performance with jammy Black‑Throated Wind and a lovely Love Light, while Jerry sounds introspective but on his game.
ai_review.review: The show is described as "quite hot work" for the year, highlighted by an extended jam on Black‑Throated Wind and a beautiful rendition of Love Light. Jerry Garcia’s playing is noted as introspective yet solid. No specific recording flaws are mentioned, suggesting an acceptable audience capture.
